## DeviceCertificate\.Validate\(NetworkContext\) Method

Validates the certificate's keys, identity, validity\-window structure, size, and both device and account signatures\.

#### Parameters

<a name='Meshline.Models.Protocol.DeviceCertificate.Validate(Meshline.Models.NetworkContext).context'></a>

`context` [NetworkContext](Meshline.Models.NetworkContext.md 'Meshline\.Models\.NetworkContext')

The required network context for identity and signature validation\.

#### Returns
[ProtocolViolation](Meshline.Validation.ProtocolViolation.md 'Meshline\.Validation\.ProtocolViolation')<br>
The first detected protocol violation, or [null](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null 'https://docs\.microsoft\.com/en\-us/dotnet/csharp/language\-reference/keywords/null') if the implemented checks pass\.

#### Exceptions

[System\.ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception 'System\.ArgumentNullException')<br>
[context](Meshline.Models.Protocol.DeviceCertificate.md#Meshline.Models.Protocol.DeviceCertificate.Validate(Meshline.Models.NetworkContext).context 'Meshline\.Models\.Protocol\.DeviceCertificate\.Validate\(Meshline\.Models\.NetworkContext\)\.context') is null\.

[System\.Security\.Cryptography\.CryptographicException](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.security.cryptography.cryptographicexception 'System\.Security\.Cryptography\.CryptographicException')<br>
The cryptographic provider cannot perform account or relay signature verification; ordinary invalid signatures are returned as protocol violations\.

### Remarks
This checks both signatures and the certificate validity\-window structure\. It does not require the current time to lie within that window; check account device authorization separately\.
